title: eval-set/1: what this repo holds of a held-out eval set: the Role and Intent it tests, the count of cases, and each case's id and the sha256 of its file in the private home. A gate set says so, and of each case whether it is natural: a fresh set the gate reads, whose report is of counts alone (issue 612), with its own bars, least of a kind and the record that states them, and the development cases each of its dispatches asks first (issue 613). No case content is here, and none may be.

gate.description: Whether this is a gate set, whose report is eval-aggregate/1, of counts alone; absent, a development set, whose report is eval-report/1.

bars.description: A gate set's own bar for each kind, as a whole fraction [passed, of], applied to its cases summed over every dispatch on a commit (issue 613); no other set gives any.

kind_least.description: How many cases of each kind a gate set must hold (issue 613); no other set gives it.

record.description: The decision record that states a gate set's bars and least of a kind, word for word as `harness.eval.bars_said` gives them (issue 613).

preflight.description: The cases of the review Intent's development set, `evals/pr-review`, by id, that each dispatch of a gate set asks first and scores apart, so that a broken pipeline stops the dispatch before any of the gate set's cases is asked (issue 613). None may be a gate set's case, by its id or its hash; no other set gives any.

natural.description: Whether the case was taken from a change as it was made, or built for the set: counted apart in a gate set's report, and never given to the Role.
